title: Multicloud, Multi-CDNs (Content Delivery Networks) Architecture – A Deceptive Future of the Internet
content: The last two years stood witness to multiple internet outages that caused massive disruptions across the globe. One prevalent theory is that multicloud, multi-CDNs (content delivery networks) are the inevitable future of the internet. This article conducts a litmus test on this theory and tries to expose the chinks in the armor.
